item.desc: After spending 10 days in China, one thing became very clear to me. The conversation shouldn’t be “China vs India.” China is competing on a different playing field altogether. Whether it’s high-speed rail, manufacturing, electric vehicles, digital payments, infrastructure, or large-scale technology, China has spent decades building systems at a scale that’s hard to fully appreciate until you see them yourself. That doesn’t mean other countries can’t catch up. But right now, comparing China to India misses the bigger picture. China isn’t just trying to lead its region—it’s competing with the world’s biggest economies across almost every major industry. Travel has a funny way of challenging what you think you know. Seeing China with my own eyes completely changed my perspective. #china #chinatravel #solotravel #travelexperiences #shanghai

contents.desc: After spending 10 days in China, one thing became very clear to me.
The conversation shouldn’t be “China vs India.”
China is competing on a different playing field altogether.

Whether it’s high-speed rail, manufacturing, electric vehicles, digital payments, infrastructure, or large-scale technology, China has spent decades building systems at a scale that’s hard to fully appreciate until you see them yourself.

That doesn’t mean other countries can’t catch up. But right now, comparing China to India misses the bigger picture. China isn’t just trying to lead its region—it’s competing with the world’s biggest economies across almost every major industry.
Travel has a funny way of challenging what you think you know. Seeing China with my own eyes completely changed my perspective.

Why comeback? Because before the century of humiliation, for thousands of years, China was one of the most advanced civilization being the centre of trade, knowledge, ideas and culture that many countries would send their scholars to learn from China and bring it back to their own country. . . . . . . . . . #china #chineseculture #chinatravel
